# Doctor Brace

> > Doctor Brace is a medical hosiery retailer specializing in compression socks, stockings, and braces for venous insufficiency, varicose veins, and circulation support.

Doctor Brace offers a comprehensive catalog of compression garments across multiple compression levels (20-30 mmHg and 30-40 mmHg) and specialized collections for different demographics and medical conditions. The site features leading brands including Softmedi, Circutrend, and Actiman, with products available in the USA and Canada.

## Key Topics

- Compression socks
- Compression stockings
- Venous insufficiency
- Varicose veins
- Graduated compression
- Medical-grade compression
- mmHg compression levels
- Circutrend
- Softmedi
- Actiman
- Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI)
- Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) prevention
- Medical hosiery
- Graded compression
- Compression therapy

## Compression Socks by Style

- [Compression Stockings - Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/compression-stockings): Main compression stockings collection with Softmedi and Actiman brands
- [Knee High Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/knee-high-compression-socks): Knee-high compression socks for varicose veins and edema relief
- [Thigh High Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/thigh-high-compression-socks): Thigh-high compression socks with Circutrend brand for leg swelling
- [Compression Pantyhose Stockings](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/compression-pantyhose-stockings): Women's compression pantyhose in 20-30 mmHg with multiple color options
- [Compression Socks With Toes](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/compression-socks-with-toes): Closed-toe compression socks with Circutrend and Softmedi brands
- [Toeless Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/toeless-compression-socks): Open-toe compression socks ideal for sandals and sensitive feet

## Compression Socks by Compression Level

- [20 30 mmHg Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/20-30-mmhg-compression-socks): Mild to moderate 20-30 mmHg compression socks for varicose veins
- [30 40 mmHg Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/30-40-mmhg-compression-socks): Medical-grade 30-40 mmHg compression for venous insufficiency
- [Graded Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/graded-compression-socks): Graded compression socks in 20-30 and 30-40 mmHg compression levels
- [Medical Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/medical-compression-socks): Prescription-grade medical compression socks for venous diseases

## Compression Socks by Demographics

- [Women's Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/womens-compression-socks): Women's compression socks in multiple styles and compression grades
- [Men's Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/mens-compression-socks): Men's compression socks with Actiman and CircuTrend brands
- [Pregnancy Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/pregnancy-compression-socks): Pregnancy compression socks for venous insufficiency during maternity
- [Compression Socks For Plus Size](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/compression-socks-for-plus-size): Plus-size compression socks in XL to 4XL sizing with Circutrend

## Specialized Compression Collections

- [Compression Socks For Nurses](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/compression-socks-for-nurses): Specialized compression socks for nurses with venous insufficiency
- [Compression Socks For Traveling](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/compression-socks-for-traveling): Travel compression socks for flights to prevent DVT and swelling
- [Diabetic Compression Socks](https://doctorbrace.com/collections/diabetic-compression-socks): Diabetic compression socks for swelling and neuropathy relief
